data.long_meaning: The name Sonju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit' meaning 'gold' and 'Ju' meaning 'born'. The name Sonju signifies the 'Son of the Goddess' or 'Golden One'. The name Sonju carries the meaning “Son of the Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sonju usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sonju holds spiritual significance as it is believed to be derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit', which represents gold. In Hinduism, gold is considered a symbol of purity, wealth, and prosperity. The name Sonju thus signifies a child who is blessed with these qualities.
